title: Automatic Sweep: Setting Up Your Sweep Program
summary: This document explains how to set up Automatic Sweep by confirming eligibility (business savings account available) and reviewing $0.00 activation fee and $0.00 ongoing monthly service fee. It covers configuring the receiving savings account plus target minimum/minimum sweep amount, activating by submitting configuration and agreeing to terms, and then monitoring and adjusting settings.
